_note: Item-level fixture (like Phase 0.1's dedupe fixtures), not raw-payload -- exercises mergeCrossSource()'s tier-ranking ARITHMETIC (1c), not parser text-extraction fidelity (which is what the work order's 'must be real prose' requirement protects for extractDeadline). Both items' description/evidence.quote are real Microsoft text about the same real change (the Agent Registry -> Agent 365 consolidation); see source notes below. The title is held identical between the two items so the merge match itself (exact-title path, already covered by Phase 0.1's tests) isn't what's under test here -- only which item WINS the merge is.
_designNote: Deliberately constructed so the winner FLIPS between the old Phase-0.1 fixed CROSS_SOURCE_RANK table and the new tier-based ranking -- 1c's whole point ('replace the CROSS_SOURCE_RANK table ... with tier-based ranking'). Under the OLD table, entra-whatsnew-md (rank 0) always beats graph-changelog (rank 1) regardless of content. To demonstrate a flip, the whats-new.md side here has its real **Type:** field omitted (a real entry lacking that field was not found in the 2026-08-14 fetch -- every H3 in that snapshot had one -- so this exercises the parser's own documented tier-B fallback path with real body text otherwise untouched), landing it at tier B. The graph-changelog side is the real Agent Registry deprecation-notice text, given tier A (graph-changelog basis) for this test. Tier A now outranks tier B, so graph-changelog wins despite losing the old fixed-table comparison.

whatsnewItemNoTypeField.description: The Agent registry and Agent collections blades in the Entra admin center will be retired on May 1, 2026. No action is required by administrators.
